episodes.title: Maharaji: The Cult That Promised Divine Light
episodes.description:
In 1960, an eight-year-old boy in India was declared a god. By 1973, he'd filled a 70,000-seat stadium. This is the rise and rebranding of Prem Rawat—'Maharaji'—and the Divine Light Mission: the global cult that promised enlightenment and delivered psychological manipulation, financial exploitation, and trauma.

We trace the chronology from his father's death through his consolidation of power in India, his strategic expansion into the West during the spiritual boom of the 1970s, the construction of a multi-million-dollar media empire, and the careful rebranding that allowed him to escape accountability.

This is the story of how a charismatic leader built an apparatus of control so sophisticated that decades later, survivors are still unpacking the damage—and how he remains active, operating under different names, with no public reckoning.

For more investigations into how belief systems are weaponized, subscribe.
